Jira Align experience. Miro experience. Workshop facilitation experience. Experience working with India-based delivery teams. Experience supporting enterprise platforms, digital products, analytics initiatives, data products, AI-enabled solutions, or large-scale transformation programs. Familiarity with Agentic AI, Databricks, or related data and development technologies. Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or other regulated-industry environments. Experience supporting organizational change and digital transformation initiatives. Functional Skills Must-Have Strong expertise in Agile methodologies, especially SAFe. Demonstrated experience balancing Product Owner and Agile delivery responsibilities. Strong backlog-management skills, including prioritization, story refinement, acceptance criteria, dependency management, and development readiness. Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Jira Align. Proven ability to facilitate Agile ceremonies and ensure adherence to effective Agile practices. Strong understanding of sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and scaled planning activities. Experience using Agile and delivery metrics to improve team execution, flow, and predictability. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a data-driven mindset. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder-management skills. Strong dependency, risk, and impediment-management capabilities. Ability to influence without authority across global and matrixed organizations. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Good-to-Have Understanding of DevOps and Test Automation pipelines. Experience facilitating workshops and Agile training sessions. Familiarity with data platforms and ETL pipelines. Familiarity with AI, analytics, data products, Agentic AI, or Databricks environments. Experience with Kanban and flow-based delivery practices. Experience supporting Program Increment planning and Agile Release Train activities. Understanding of product management, portfolio management, and roadmap-alignment practices. Excellent communication across business, scientific, and technical audiences. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language. Ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous situations. Strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Organized, collaborative, proactive, and outcome-oriented working style. Team-oriented mindset with a focus on outcomes and impact. Ability to build trust and productive relationships across functions, geographies, and organizational levels. cold_email.subject: Interest in Digital Product Manager — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Amgen Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Digital Product Manager opportunity with Amgen at Amgen.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern, Spring
jobs.description: ABOUT ABRIDGE Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients. Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. THE ROLE We're looking for Software Engineering Interns to join Abridge's Engineering team for a 3-month internship program in Spring 2027, with the possibility of extension. You'll collaborate with our engineering team to build and ship real-world features that translate cutting-edge language model capabilities into dependable clinical systems. With mentorship and guidance, you'll gain hands-on experience designing, coding, and releasing AI-powered software that makes a meaningful impact on clinicians' workflows. What You'll Do - Design and build end-to-end features, enhancing our existing systems and contributing to agentic LLM workflows (retrieval pipelines, structured tool use, chained LLM calls) - Fix user-facing bugs and issues, and make quality-of-life improvements across our backend and frontend systems - Get hands-on with evaluation frameworks that measure accuracy, robustness, and clinical reliability - Help prototype with new models, prompting techniques, and open-source orchestration tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) - Develop a strong user-centric mindset, building empathy for Abridge's clinicians and the challenges they face - Collaborate across cross-functional product teams — design, product, machine learning, and infrastructure — to ship features to our customers - Receive guidance from an experienced software engineering mentor, and collaborate one-on-one with teammates within your pod What You'll Bring - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field - A strong interest in pursuing a full-time software engineering role in 2027 — high-performing interns are eligible to receive a return offer - AI tooling is already part of how you work — you use it to write, debug, and learn faster, and you know when to trust it vs. verify - Passion for and understanding of Abridge's mission - A curious, adaptable, and proactive mindset, with a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced startup environment - A collaborative, low-ego mindset — we move fast, and we need team players who are eager to contribute wherever needed Base Salary: $40/hr Must be willing to work from our San Francisco (Potrero) office 5x per week. This internship is based in our San Francisco office. Relocation to SF will be supported through reimbursements. WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE? At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month. Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business. Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients. We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you. HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS: - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families. - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA. - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees. - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family. - 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future. - Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage. - Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits. - Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more. - Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals. - Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment. - Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees. - ... and much more! EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability. We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process. STAYING SAFE - PROTECT YOURSELF FROM RECRUITMENT FRAUD We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com http://abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate I– Reg CMC Strategy (LEC Team) opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Associate, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
jobs.description: Career Category Information Systems Job Description Associate, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN) Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. What you will do As the Associate, Medicaid – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN), you will support execution of U.S. Medicaid rebate operations within the Contracts & Pricing Execution function. This role will support invoice gathering, claim loading, validation checks, CLD processing, dispute documentation, payment package preparation, reporting, reconciliation support, SOP documentation, controls, and operational improvement activities. The role will partner with the Medicaid Manager, AIN team members, ATO Medicaid process owners, Government Pricing, Finance, Compliance, Contracting, Information Systems, and other U.S.-based stakeholders to support accurate, timely, and compliant Medicaid operations. The Associate will be expected to learn Medicaid processes through structured KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution before taking on broader independent responsibilities. Key Responsibilities Medicaid Processing & Operational Execution Support day-to-day execution of Medicaid rebate operations including invoice receipt tracking, invoice conversion, Model N upload preparation, claim processing, payment package support, and documentation maintenance. Execute assigned standard-state activities in accordance with SOPs, work instructions, checklists, quality standards, and established timelines. Maintain accurate trackers for invoice status, CLD receipt, validation outcomes, open items, dispute status, payment package readiness, and evidence retention. Flag risks, missing information, aged items, access issues, or process exceptions to the Medicaid Manager and ATO retained owners. Invoice Validation & CLD Support Perform first-pass invoice validation checks for assigned Medicaid states, including unit, NDC, reimbursement, URA, invoice, and source data reasonableness checks. Support CLD formatting, control checks, historical utilization comparison, duplicate discount screening support, and preparation of analysis files for review. Document validation findings, assumptions, supporting evidence, and required follow-up actions clearly and consistently. Escalate complex state nuances, high-risk exceptions, unusual utilization trends, or ambiguous payment/dispute issues for manager or ATO review. Dispute, Adjustment & Payment Package Support Prepare dispute documentation, dispute tracking updates, response support, and evidence files for disputed units and rebate amounts. Support preparation of ROSI, PQAS, remittance, payment package, and SharePoint archival documentation in accordance with SOP requirements. Assist with prior quarter adjustments, supplemental claim support, interest calculation evidence, and payment reconciliation support as assigned. Maintain clean audit trails, decision logs, and supporting workpapers for Medicaid invoice and payment activities. Systems, Documentation & Continuous Improvement Use Model N / PbN, SAP, Validata, SharePoint, state portals, reporting tools, and Microsoft 365 applications to support Medicaid workflow execution. Assist with UAT, defect documentation, access readiness tracking, SOP updates, work instruction drafting, training material preparation, and knowledge repository maintenance. Participate in KT, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised execution activities to build Medicaid process proficiency. Identify process gaps, manual effort reduction opportunities, recurring exceptions, documentation gaps, and quality improvement ideas. Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness Execute work in accordance with internal policies, Medicaid SOPs, controlled process requirements, documentation standards, and compliance expectations. Maintain accurate evidence for invoice receipt, validation, disputes, payment support, approvals, reconciliations, and archival steps. Escalate data integrity, compliance, financial, or operational risks promptly and support remediation activities as assigned. Support audit, SOX, and control review activities by providing complete workpapers and organized documentation. What We Expect of You We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented Medicaid / managed markets operations professional with strong analytical, documentation, and process execution capabilities. This individual should bring ownership, accuracy, curiosity, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to support compliant and timely Medicaid rebate execution. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related discipline. 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical / healthcare operations, managed markets, Medicaid rebates, finance operations, revenue management, claims operations, analytics, or related controlled business operations. Strong Excel, documentation, reporting, analytical, and follow-through skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet timelines, follow SOPs, and work effectively in a deadline-driven and highly controlled environment. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to Medicaid rebate operations, payer rebates, managed markets finance, claims validation, CLD processing, dispute tracking, rebate adjudication, Gross-to-Net, or pharmaceutical revenue management. Experience with Model N / PbN, Validata, Revitas Flex, SAP, SharePoint, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Power Automate, or comparable tools. Understanding of NDC, AMP, Best Price, URA, AWP, ROSI, PQAS, 340B duplicate discount concepts, managed care utilization, and compliance documentation is desirable. Experience supporting SOPs, WSIs, audit-ready workpapers, issue trackers, UAT, system implementation, automation, or process improvement activities. Strong collaboration, communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and ability to work with U.S.-based stakeholders in a distributed global operating model. .

jobs.title: Associate, Membership – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN)
jobs.description: Career Category Information Systems Job Description Associate, Membership – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN) Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career. What you will do As a Senior Associate, Membership – Contracts & Pricing Execution (AIN) , you will support the execution of U.S. pharmaceutical Membership operations by managing customer eligibility, GPO alignments, membership validations, customer setup, contract alignment, and membership maintenance activities. You will serve as a critical link between Market Access, Contracting, Pricing, Chargebacks, MDM, Government Pricing, wholesalers, GPOs, and customers to ensure accurate customer eligibility and contract execution across the Amgen commercial contracting landscape. The role supports the end-to-end Membership process from receipt of customer requests through validation, setup, system alignment, and ongoing maintenance. Key Responsibilities Membership Operations & Customer Eligibility Support the end-to-end membership process including customer onboarding, eligibility validation, membership maintenance, GPO alignments, and customer relationship updates. Review and triage incoming membership requests received through the Membership mailbox from GPOs, wholesalers, Key Account Managers (KAMs), Contracting teams, and other stakeholders. Validate customer information submitted through Declaration (DEC) Forms, rosters, and customer requests to ensure completeness and compliance with contractual requirements. Determine customer eligibility based on contract terms, class of trade (COT), GPO participation, and business-specific membership requirements. Support execution against established service level agreements (SLAs) and communicate status updates or delays to stakeholders as needed. Customer Validation & Membership Maintenance Perform customer validation activities utilizing HIN, DEA, HIBCC, HRSA, OneKey, HCM, GCPS, and other approved reference sources. Review Declaration (DEC) Forms for accuracy, completeness, valid signatures, proper customer identifiers, and current forms before processing. Validate parent-child relationships, legal entity hierarchies (LEH), customer attributes, and customer master data prior to customer setup. Maintain membership records, customer alignments, contract affiliations, and GPO relationships within approved systems. Support customer adds, drops, strategy realignments, and membership updates resulting from acquisitions, organizational changes, roster updates, and contract transitions. Customer Setup & Systems Management Create and maintain customer records within HCM, GCPS, SAP, and related systems supporting commercial contract operations. Support customer onboarding activities including customer setup, LEH creation, customer attribute maintenance, and contract alignment. Coordinate with MDM teams to support customer record creation, updates, master data corrections, and hierarchy management. Monitor and validate system interfaces between HCM, SAP, GCPS, and related applications to ensure successful data synchronization. Investigate and resolve customer setup, interface, and data integrity issues impacting contract eligibility and pricing access. Membership Reporting & Eligibility Management Develop, validate, and distribute eligibility reports supporting GPOs, wholesalers, Market Access teams, and other stakeholders. Perform ongoing review of dispute reports and customer listings to identify missing, misaligned, or new customers requiring setup or updates. Support customer eligibility validations related to contract participation, GPO membership, specialty pharmacy programs, hospital coalitions, and other business-specific arrangements Analyze membership trends, customer changes, roster updates, and operational metrics to support business decisions and improve data quality. Rebuttals, Dispute Resolution & Stakeholder Support Investigate customer eligibility disputes and support rebuttal activities with GPOs and external stakeholders. Review denial requests, perform customer eligibility research, prepare supporting rationale, and maintain appropriate documentation of decisions. Collaborate with Membership leadership, Contracting, Pricing, Chargebacks, Government Pricing, and external customers to resolve membership-related inquiries and issues. Maintain complete documentation and audit trails supporting membership decisions, customer alignments, and eligibility determinations. PHS, 340B & Specialized Membership Programs Support quarterly Public Health Service (PHS) and 340B eligibility updates, customer validation activities, and contract maintenance processes. cold_email.subject: Interest in Associate Manager I - Reg CMC Strategy (LEC Team) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Associate Manager I - Reg CMC Strategy (LEC Team) opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in building scalable data systems that let research and clinical teams use biological data reliably. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, I have built API-driven and Snakemake-based pipelines, automated SQL workflows, and worked across both scientific and software contexts.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: GTM Readiness Manager
jobs.description: Role Description As a GTM Readiness Manager within the GTM organization, you will help turn product and business changes into executable go-to-market motions. You will work across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Enablement, and Technology to ensure the business is operationally ready to bring new products, packaging, and other commercial changes to market. You will play a critical role in translating product decisions into GTM requirements, identifying cross-functional dependencies, coordinating operational readiness, and ensuring the end-to-end customer and seller experience works as intended. This role sits at the intersection of product and commercial execution, giving you broad exposure across the business and the opportunity to improve how we bring increasingly complex products and commercial models to market. You will serve as a critical connection point between Product and the teams responsible for bringing product changes to market, ensuring teams are aligned and operationally ready for launch. You will also help build and scale the GTM Readiness capability, creating clearer processes, identifying dependencies earlier, reducing launch friction, and enabling teams to move faster and execute with greater confidence. Responsibilities Own GTM readiness for product and commercial changes , including new product launches, pricing and packaging changes, new SKUs, migrations, deprecations, and changes to routes to market. Translate product decisions into commercial and operational requirements across areas such as product catalog, pricing and approvals, contracting, Salesforce/CPQ, billing and ordering, provisioning and entitlements, compensation, reporting, and customer lifecycle. Partner with Product teams early in the development lifecycle to understand upcoming changes, identify impacted GTM motions, and establish the decisions, owners, dependencies, and lead times required for readiness. Orchestrate cross-functional readiness across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Enablement, GTM Technology, and other impacted teams, while maintaining clear accountability with the teams that own individual decisions and deliverables. Drive end-to-end operational validation , defining critical business scenarios and ensuring appropriate owners validate the complete customer and seller experience across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, reporting, renewal, support, and other applicable workflows. Identify and manage readiness risks , surfacing unresolved decisions, dependencies, and operational gaps early and driving them toward resolution or explicit risk acceptance before launch. Improve the GTM Readiness operating model by creating reusable processes, launch patterns, requirements frameworks, and automation that reduce manual coordination and make future launches faster and more predictable. Requirements At least 8 years of overall professional experience. 5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Systems, or another role supporting complex cross-functional GTM initiatives. Demonstrated experience supporting product launches, pricing/packaging changes, commercial model changes, or other initiatives requiring coordination between Product and GTM teams. Working knowledge of core SaaS commercial processes, including multiple areas such as opportunity-to-order, quoting/CPQ, pricing, contracting, billing, provisioning, renewals, compensation, or customer lifecycle management. Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product or business needs into clear operational requirements, dependencies, decisions, and execution plans. Experience independently coordinating complex initiatives across Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Sales, and other business functions without direct authority over participating teams. Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand how a change in one part of the commercial lifecycle can affect downstream processes, systems, data, and customer experiences. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience documenting requirements, facilitating cross-functional decisions, communicating risks, and driving clarity among stakeholders with different priorities. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based business with multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market. Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, billing, commerce, provisioning, entitlement, or other systems supporting the quote-to-cash/customer lifecycle. Experience designing or improving product launch, commercialization, or GTM readiness processes rather than solely executing within an established process. Experience supporting products sold through multiple motions, such as self-service, direct sales, channel, reseller, or partner ecosystems. Familiarity with automation and AI capabilities that can simplify requirements gathering, dependency management, testing, and operational readiness. Durable Skills AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others .
